thread:
Ada: Heads-up — staging showed flip-flop between primary/v3 and fallback/v2 for ~90s. Pattern: short cache misses + single 502 spike.
Thomas: Saw it. Router reacted too fast. We need a 'signal fuse' concept to absorb microbursts.
Yuri: Define: fuse = require K signals in T before action, plus a short deadtime after a flip. That deadtime should be part of the policy so it's auditable.
Ada: Agreed. Proposed policy snippet:
```json
{"policy":"signal_fuse_v1","fuse": {"k":4,"t_sec":12},"deadtime_ms":3000,"recover":{"k":10,"t_sec":40}}
```
Thomas: UX: card shows 'active variant' + 'last_flip_reason'. Clicking opens: timeline + small buffer dump (30s). Include 'policy snapshot id' link.
Yuri: Telemetry: emit fallback.decision{policy,snapshot,reason} and fallback.fuse_fill_count. Also emit a small event with buffer_sample attached to the audit log.
ops-bot: Incident I-2026-999 created by Ada — P2. Link: https://internal/trace/I-2026-999
deploy-bot: Canary with ring-buffer enabled scheduled at 1761112240.
Ada: Next steps: Thomas wires policy enforcement in router (policy-first), Yuri exposes metrics & buffer export, I'll draft RFC + console mock. Target: end of week.
